name: Feldy
long_description:
Feldy is field-first AI for home service businesses helping teams capture jobsites, create take-offs & estimates, and documentation.

With Feldy, teams capture the physical world using photos, videos, AI jobsite walkthroughs, and 3D scans using your mobile phone. It turns field information into takeoffs & estimates, visual designs, and project documentation. Feldy works across home services such as roofing, exteriors, remodeling, painting, cleaning, landscaping, handymen, and other home services.

We’re building a new way for more than 2 million U.S. home service businesses operating in an $800B+ market to capture, understand, and complete work in the field.

Feldy is available on iOS, Android, and the web.
